films.title: Ulysses
films.description: Camerini's peplum keeps Odysseus' wary lieutenant among the Aeaean scouts — the man who refuses Circe's cup and later urges the slaughter on Thrinacia.

films.title: The Odyssey
films.description: Konchalovsky's Eurylochus leads the party to Circe's house and later argues for the Sun-god's cattle — second-in-command as foil and tempter.

films.title: L'Odissea
films.description: Rossi's Odyssey retains Eurylochus as the voice that doubts the witch and then dooms the crew on Helios' island.

popCulture.title: Odyssey
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Books 10 and 12: the scout who alone escapes Circe's hall, and the speaker who persuades the starving crew to kill the cattle of the Sun.

popCulture.title: Eurylochus
popCulture.description: Odysseus' companion and kinsman by marriage — remembered as the cautious scout on Aeaea and the fatal voice on Thrinacia.
